Vetiva Griffin 30 ETF - tracks the NGX 30 Index, which holds conventional (interest-based) banks (Zenith Bank, GTCO, UBA, etc.) and other companies that fail the business-activity screen directly as portfolio constituents; a Shariah-compliant investor cannot look through to only the permissible names inside a passively-replicated index fund.

Lotus Halal Equity ETF, managed by Lotus Capital - explicitly tracks the NGX-Lotus Islamic Index, which is pre-screened to exclude conventional banks, insurance, alcohol, gambling and other impermissible activities, with financial-ratio screening (debt, cash, interest income) built into index eligibility. The only NGX-listed equity ETF designed from inception to be Shariah-compliant.

NewGold ETF - each unit represents a claim on physical gold bullion held in a vault, and gold itself is a permissible asset. However, AAOIFI Shariah Standard No. 57 requires immediate/constructive possession and same-session settlement for gold trades to avoid riba al-fadl/gharar; Concerns on NewGold's custodial and settlement structure (allocated vs unallocated bullion, T+ settlement cycle).
Stanbic IBTC ETF 30 - tracks the same NGX 30 Index as VETGRIF30, so it directly holds conventional banks and other impermissible constituents as core portfolio holdings.

Vetiva Banking ETF - tracks the NGX Banking Index, i.e. a basket of the top 10 conventional (interest-based) banks listed on NGX; a dedicated sector fund investing exclusively in an impermissible activity.

Vetiva Consumer Goods ETF - tracks the NGX Consumer Goods Index (top 15 Food/Beverage/Tobacco companies by market cap). Index composition sector historically includes brewers (Nigerian Breweries, Guinness, International Breweries) alongside permissible food/personal-care names; Concerns with buisness case mix from constituent weights.

Vetiva Industrial ETF - tracks the NGX Industrial Index (top 10 Industrial Goods companies). The sector is dominated by cement, paints, and building-materials manufacturers that generally pass a standalone business-activity screen; Concerns with regards exact verdict of constituent and the weights of each.

Greenwich Alpha ETF - tracks the broad NGX All-Share Index, which includes conventional banks, insurers, breweries and other impermissible names as core constituents alongside permissible companies; a market-cap-weighted all-share tracker cannot exclude these holdings.

Meristem Growth ETF - tracks a growth-oriented basket of NGX-listed equities (Meristem Growth Index). Contain companies that historically spanned multiple sectors including financial services; Concerns are with regards exact verdict of constituent companies and the weights of each.
Meristem Value ETF - tracks a value-oriented basket of NGX-listed equities (Meristem Value Index); Concerns are with regards exact verdict of constituent companies and the weights of each.

Vetiva S&P Nigeria Sovereign Bond ETF - holds a basket of Federal Government of Nigeria bonds and generates its return from fixed coupon (interest) income; a conventional fixed-income instrument, which is riba by definition.

SIAML Pension ETF 40 - tracks the NGX Pension Index (top 40 pension-fund-eligible companies across all sectors), which includes conventional banks and insurers as core constituents; a broad-based tracker cannot exclude these impermissible holdings.
